sn6.8:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā divāvihāragato hoti paṭisallīno || || 3.
sn6.8:1.3: Atha kho Subrahmā ca paccekabrahmā Suddhavāso capaccekabrahmā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā paccekadvārabāhaṃ nissāya aṭṭhaṃsu || || 4.
sn6.8:1.4: Atha kho Suddhāvāso. paccekabrahmā KatamodakaTissakaṃ bhikkhum ārabbha Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
